name: legacy-code-testing
description: Adds tests to legacy code that has none, safely: characterization tests that pin current behavior (including bugs) before any refactoring, seam identification for breaking untestable dependencies, and a risk-ranked coverage strategy. Use for untested or inherited codebases. Triggers on: "add tests to legacy code", "this code has no tests", "characterization tests", "make this testable", "safe to refactor?", "pin down current behavior", "test this old module before we change it".
